_comment: Models CodeAF may use, served to it by proxy.py as an OpenRouter-shaped catalog. Prices are USD per million tokens, from https://synthetic.new/pricing (usage-based) / GET https://api.synthetic.new/openai/v1/models, checked 2026-10-15. 'id' is what CodeAF sees; 'upstream' is the synthetic.new model id.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash (synthetic.new)
models.efforts_note: synthetic.new also lists 'low', but GLM at low returns an empty answer (all reasoning, no content; tested 2026-10-15), so low requests are sent as high
